title: Two For The Price Of One: Curvature-Aware Pruning Preserves Influence Functions Too
abstract: arXiv:2610.18516v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Post-training pruning enables efficient deployment, but conventional methods do not explicitly preserve internal-gradient alignment between sparse and dense models. We study novel connections between downstream performance of compressed models and the ability to retain gradient information via influence-function preservation. Central to this connection is a curvature-aware objective that accounts for both layer activations and backpropagated gradients. Despite its promise, this objective remains underexplored in pruning due to a lack of efficient solvers. We introduce $\texttt{CACTUS}$, a novel ADMM-based optimizer supporting both pruning and sparse-plus-low-rank decompositions of pre-trained weights. Compared to LLM-Surgeon which targets the same objective, $\texttt{CACTUS}$ can achieve over an order-of-magnitude speedup. translated_title: 一石二鸟：曲率感知剪枝同时保留影响函数
translated_abstract: 训练后剪枝能够实现模型的高效部署，但传统方法并未显式地保留稀疏模型与稠密模型之间的内部梯度对齐。我们研究了压缩模型的下游性能与通过影响函数保留来维持梯度信息的能力之间的新联系。这一联系的核心是一个曲率感知的目标函数，它同时考虑了层激活和反向传播的梯度。尽管前景可观，但由于缺乏高效的求解器，该目标函数在剪枝领域仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了CACTUS，一种基于ADMM的新型优化器，既支持对预训练权重进行剪枝，也支持稀疏加低秩分解。与针对相同目标的LLM-Surgeon相比，CACTUS可以实现超过一个数量级的加速。在对Qwen3-4B进行50%剪枝时，CACTUS将C4困惑度与稠密模型的差距降低了45%，……
tldr: 提出了基于ADMM的曲率感知剪枝优化器CACTUS，能够在剪枝和稀疏加低秩分解中保留影响函数所依赖的梯度信息，相比LLM-Surgeon速度提升超过一个数量级，并显著缩小稀疏模型与稠密模型之间的困惑度差距。
en_tdlr: CACTUS, a curvature-aware ADMM-based optimizer for pruning and sparse-plus-low-rank decomposition, preserves influence functions while achieving over an order-of-magnitude speedup over LLM-Surgeon and substantially reducing the perplexity gap between sparse and dense models.
